Vendored third-party headers
=============================

`reaper-sdk/sdk/reaper_plugin.h` and `reaper-sdk/sdk/reaper_plugin_functions.h`
are copied verbatim from:

  https://github.com/justinfrankel/reaper-sdk (branch: main)
  Header comment marks it as "Generated by REAPER v7.79".

`reaper-sdk/WDL/swell/swell.h`, `swell-types.h`, `swell-functions.h` are
copied verbatim from:

  https://github.com/justinfrankel/WDL (branch: main)

Only these three SWELL headers are vendored (not the full WDL tree) because
`reaper_plugin.h` only pulls in `../WDL/swell/swell.h`, which in turn only
includes `swell-types.h` and `swell-functions.h` (verified by grepping their
`#include` directives) plus standard C library headers. We never link SWELL's
own implementation (`swell-cocoa.mm` etc.) — REAPER already has SWELL built
in; we only need the *type declarations* (e.g. `HWND`) that `reaper_plugin.h`
exposes in its public API surface.

Both projects are distributed under a permissive zlib-style license (see the
header comments inside each file): free to use, modify, and redistribute,
including in commercial products, provided the license notice isn't stripped.

If you need to refresh these headers later (e.g. for a newer REAPER API
version), re-download the same five files from the URLs above and diff
against what's here — do not hand-edit them.
